7.stem_plain: I am going to buy some stationery __________ the school bookshop.

8.stem_plain: While he was on his way home, my father __________ shocked when a dog dashed out in front of him.

9.stem_plain: Peter and his sister __________ delighted when they found their lost rabbit.

10.stem_plain: "Keep your voices down. The baby __________ right now," said Aunt Mary when we visited her.

11.stem_plain: Last Sunday, we __________ the library books before going to the mall.

12.stem_plain: While Mother __________ dinner, the doorbell rang.

13.stem_plain: __________ boy playing on the swing over there is my brother.

14.stem_plain: Sally can play both the piano __________ the violin very well.

15.stem_plain: Michael who sits only __________ tables away from me in class is my best friend.

16.stem_plain: Dogs need __________ space to exercise, so you have to take them out for walks regularly.

7.zh: 我打算去学校书店买些文具。
7.note: “the school bookshop” 表示一个具体的具体地点或场所，介词通常使用 at。
7.concept: 地点介词 — Prepositions of Place — at

8.zh: 在他回家的路上，当一只狗突然窜到他面前时，我的父亲吓了一跳。
8.note: 从句中的 “was” 提示整个语境处于过去时态，主语 “my father” 是单数，因此系动词应选 was。
8.concept: 系动词过去时与时态一致 — Simple Past Tense of 'be'

9.zh: 当彼得和他的妹妹找到他们丢失的兔子时，他们很高兴。
9.note: 主语 “Peter and his sister” 是复数，且时间状语从句 “when they found” 提示过去发生的事情，故用复数过去式 were。
9.concept: 主谓一致与一般过去时 — Subject-Verb Agreement & Simple Past Tense

10.zh: “小声点。婴儿现在正在睡觉，”玛丽阿姨在我们拜访她时说道。
10.note: “right now”（现在，此刻）明确提示动作正在进行，因此动词使用现在进行时 is sleeping。
10.concept: 现在进行时 — Present Continuous Tense

11.zh: 上个星期天，我们在去商场之前把图书馆的书还了。
11.note: “Last Sunday”（上个星期天）明确提示过去时间，谓语动词应选用一般过去式 returned。
11.concept: 一般过去时 — Simple Past Tense

12.zh: 当妈妈正在做晚饭时，门铃响了。
12.note: “While” 引导的时间状语从句表示过去一个正在持续进行的背景动作，因此主句动词使用过去进行时 was preparing。
12.concept: 过去进行时 — Past Continuous Tense

13.zh: 在那边荡秋千的那个男孩是我弟弟。
13.note: “boy” 为单数名词，且 “over there”（在那边）表示空间距离较远，因此使用表示单数远称的指示代词 That。
13.concept: 指示代词 — Demonstrative Pronouns — That

14.zh: 莎莉弹钢琴和拉小提琴都非常出色。
14.note: “both ... and ...” 是并列连词的固定搭配，意为“既……又……”。
14.concept: 并列连词搭配 — Correlative Conjunctions — both...and

15.zh: 在班里只坐在离我几张桌子远处的迈克尔是我最好的朋友。
15.note: “tables” 是可数名词复数，且由前面的 “only”（仅仅）修饰，表达数量很少，故用 a few 修饰。
15.concept: 可数名词修饰语 — Quantifiers with Countable Nouns — a few

16.zh: 狗需要大量的空间来运动，所以你必须定期带它们出去散步。
16.note: “space”（空间）在此处是不可数名词，根据后半句定期带去散步的逻辑，它们需要“很多”空间，因而选用符合修饰不可数名词的量词短语 a lot of。
16.concept: 不可数名词修饰语 — Quantifiers with Uncountable Nouns — a lot of

1.stem_plain: When Jane saw the lizard, she was __________ and screamed with fear.

2.stem_plain: This piece of music was written by a famous __________.

3.stem_plain: Jack __________ about the room as he had twisted his ankle.

4.stem_plain: Grandmother carries her crystal vase to the table carefully as it is __________.

5.stem_plain: The __________ crept through the jungle with his rifle, tracking the pangolin.

6.stem_plain: The students bit their fingernails __________ as their teacher handed out their examination results.

1.zh: 当简看到蜥蜴时，她被吓坏了，恐惧地尖叫起来。
1.note: “screamed with fear”（恐惧地尖叫）是核心线索，提示心理状态是极度害怕，因此选用 “terrified”（非常害怕的，极度惊恐的）。
1.concept: 形容词词义辨析与情感搭配 — Vocabulary (Adjectives) — terrified

choices.eg: He became highly irritated by the constant noise outside his window.
The little child was terrified of the dark and always left the lamp on.
She felt deeply annoyed when her computer suddenly froze again.
He was embarrassed when he called his teacher by the wrong name.

2.zh: 这首乐曲是由一位著名的作曲家谱写的。
2.note: “piece of music”（乐曲）和 “written”（创作、谱写）相呼应，写音乐的人被称为 “composer”（作曲家）。
2.concept: 职业名词词义辨析 — Vocabulary (Nouns) — composer

choices.zh: 作者，作家（通常指书籍或文章的创作者）
choices.eg: The young author spent three years writing her first fantasy novel.
He is a regular writer for a prominent technology magazine.
The brave journalist traveled to the front lines to cover the story.
Beethoven is widely regarded as one of the greatest composers in history.

3.zh: 杰克在房间里一瘸一拐地走着，因为他扭伤了脚踝。
3.note: “twisted his ankle”（扭伤了脚踝）是原因，对应的走路姿态必然是 “limped”（一瘸一拐地走）。
3.concept: 行走动作动词辨析 — Vocabulary (Verbs) — limped

choices.eg: The pet cat jumped onto the kitchen counter to steal the fish.
The graceful deer leaped over the high wooden fence effortlessly.
The injured football player limped off the stadium field slowly.
The joyful schoolgirls skipped along the sidewalk on their way home.

4.zh: 奶奶小心翼翼地把她的水晶花瓶拿到桌上，因为它很易碎。
4.note: “crystal vase”（水晶花瓶）以及 “carefully”（小心翼翼地）说明这个物体属于易碎品，最标准的修饰形容词是 “fragile”（易碎的）。
4.concept: 物品属性形容词辨析 — Vocabulary (Adjectives) — fragile

choices.zh: 虚弱的，无力的（多指人或身体）
choices.eg: He still felt slightly weak after recovering from a severe flu.

choices.zh: 劣质的，不结实的，单薄的（常指纸张、结构或借口）
choices.eg: The strong wind blew down the flimsy plastic tent within minutes.
The steak was exceptionally tender and cooked to perfection.
Please handle these fragile glass ornaments with utmost care.

5.zh: 那个偷猎者提着步枪悄悄穿过丛林，追踪着穿山甲。
5.note: 手持“步枪”（rifle），并且在丛林中非法“追踪穿山甲”（tracking the pangolin，一种受保护的野生动物），其身份属于 “poacher”（偷猎者）。
5.concept: 名词词义辨析与背景理解 — Vocabulary (Nouns) — poacher

choices.eg: The eagle scanned the grassland below for its small mammal prey.
Leopards are skilled predators that hunt effectively in the dark.
Park rangers arrested a poacher who was setting traps for tigers.

choices.zh: 食腐动物（吃死尸的动物）
choices.eg: Vultures act as nature's scavengers by feeding on animal carcasses.

6.zh: 当老师发考试成绩时，学生们紧张地咬着指甲。
6.note: “bit their fingernails”（咬指甲）是典型的内心焦虑外在行为。在发成绩（handing out examination results）的情境下，选用副词 “nervously”（紧张地）。
6.concept: 副词词义辨析与举止特征 — Vocabulary (Adverbs) — nervously

choices.eg: She sighed sadly as she packed her bags to leave the city.
The toddler rubbed his eyes sleepily during the long car ride.
The family smiled happily for a portrait picture in front of their home.
He paced up and down the corridor nervously before his job interview.

21.stem_plain: According to the visual text, the main purpose is to ________.

21.note: 解释为什么选这个答案 — replace stems, passages, and teaching copy when content is ready.

22.note: 指代翠鸟“乔伊（Joey）的家人”。在前文中，作者使用He来指代Joey（He looks for fish...），说明在这里将这只雄性动物拟人化，修饰名词family，故使用男性形容词性物主代词“his”（他的）。

23.note: 指代上文提到的“鱼（fish）”。从后文的系动词are（复数）以及意为“非常美味”可知，这里的fish代表复数概念的鱼群，在句中作主语，故使用复数人称代词主格“they”（它们）。

24.note: 指代前文提到的“石油泄漏（oil leaked from a boat）”这一事件或泄漏出来的石油（oil）。在句中作has disrupted的主语，由于是单数无生命概念，故使用人称代词主格“it”（它）。

25.note: 指代“乔伊和他的朋友们（Joey and his friends）的食物供应”。修饰名词短语food supply，因为是指代复数群体的所有物，故使用复数形容词性物主代词“their”（他们的）。

cloze: Joey, a kingfisher, lives in a mangrove tree in Pulau Ubin. Every morning, Joey hunts for food with [Q22] family. He looks for fish in the rivers as [Q23] are delicious.

Recently, oil leaked from a boat and [Q24] has disrupted the lives of many animals on the island. Joey and his friends are worried as [Q25] food supply is decreasing. Joey hopes the waters can be cleaned up soon.
zh: 乔伊是一只翠鸟，生活在乌敏岛的一棵红树林树上。每天早晨，乔伊都会和他的家人一起寻找食物。他在河流里寻找鱼，因为它们非常美味。
最近，一艘船发生了石油泄漏，这破坏了岛上许多动物的生活。乔伊和他的朋友们很担心，因为它们的食物供应正在减少。乔伊希望水域能尽快清理干净。

34.stem_plain: This is the house. Its roof was blown off in the storm.

35.stem_plain: I can buy a cup of coffee from the shop. I can buy a bottle of milk too.

34.zh: 这就是那栋在暴风雨中屋顶被吹走的房子。
34.note: 使用关系代词‘whose’引导定语从句，替代形容词性物主代词‘Its’，修饰先行词‘house’。
34.answer: This is the house whose roof was blown off in the storm.

35.zh: 我可以从这家店买一杯咖啡，或者买一瓶牛奶。
35.note: 使用‘either ... or ...’连接两个并列的宾语成分，表示二选一。重合的谓语和地点‘I can buy ... from the shop’可作省略或语序调整。
35.answer: I can buy either a cup of coffee or a bottle of milk from the shop.
